title: Compute and invert a length-three DFT over F4

source.citation: Jackson Walters, The Modular DFT of the Symmetric Group, arXiv:2404.05796

translation.notes: The source's cyclic modular DFT construction is specialized to N=3 over F4. The defining modulus makes the field generator a primitive cube root, and forward/inverse transforms are checked exactly.
